snippet.description:
The most ICONIC fall view in the US🍁

Follow americantravelarchives for more hidden gems and bucket list adventures across the U.S.

📍 Artist’s Bluff, Franconia Notch State Park, New Hampshire

Artist’s Bluff is one of the most famous fall views in New England, and once you’re up there you’ll see why. From the top you look down on Echo Lake with Cannon Mountain behind it, and in peak season every inch of the notch is red, orange, and gold. The hike is short, but it doesn’t feel easy.

Why it’s worth the climb:
🍂 One of the best fall foliage views in all of New England
💧 Echo Lake sits right below, surrounded by color
🏔 Cannon Mountain and Franconia Notch fill the whole view
📸 It’s one of the most photographed spots in the White Mountains
⏱ The trail is short, so you get a huge payoff without spending all day on it
⠀
Pro Tip: Get there early. This trail gets very busy in the fall, and the parking fills up fast. It’s short but steep and pretty technical, with rocks and roots most of the way, so wear real hiking shoes and take your time, especially if it’s wet.

Leave No Trace: Stay on the marked trail, pack out everything you bring, and be careful near the edge of the bluff.⠀

Sources- World Health Organization, AAP, RCPCH 
Caitlin and Leah on TT 

Breastmilk provides a perfectly balanced blend of essential nutrients, protective antibodies, and live beneficial bacteria tailored specifically to a growing baby's needs. These vital components strengthen the infant's developing immune system, reducing the risk of common childhood illnesses like ear infections, respiratory bugs, and gastrointestinal issues. Furthermore, breastmilk contains unique fatty acids, including DHA, which support healthy brain development and cognitive growth during these critical early stages. The physical act of nursing also fosters deep emotional bonding and physical comfort through sustained skin-to-skin contact, helping the baby regulate their body temperature, heart rate, and stress levels. Beyond these immediate comfort benefits, the active jaw and mouth movements involved in breastfeeding promote proper oral and facial muscle development. This healthy physical foundation supports future functions like chewing, swallowing, and the natural alignment of developing teeth and jaw structures.

snippet.title: « Le racisme tue » : à qui la faute ? (1/4) - C Ce Soir
snippet.description:
Pour voir d'autres émissions 👉 https://bit.ly/CCeSoir
_________________________________________________________________
Dans #CCeSoir, cette question posée par la famille de Pengo Bossio Wangi, tué à Trappes le 23 octobre : comment faire en sorte que sa mort serve à quelque chose ? 
Comment passer de l’indignation à la protection de Français noirs et arabes qui se disent de plus en plus angoissés ? Faut-il aller jusqu’à l’interdiction de thèses comme le grand remplacement ou de médias comme la chaîne CNEWS ou est-ce une entorse à la liberté d’expression ?
On en débat avec les invités de Karim Rissouli de ce mardi 3 novembre 2026 :

- Zineb ALAMI, avocate de Bolema Bossio Wangi, père de Pengo Bossio Wangi
- Alexis LÉVRIER, maître de conférences à l’université de Reims, historien de la presse et des médias
- Constance RIVIÈRE, directrice générale du Palais de la porte Dorée 
- Alain JAKUBOWICZ, avocat et ancien président de la LICRA, la Ligue internationale contre le racisme et l’antisémitisme
- Jérémie PATRIER-LEITUS, député Horizons de la 3e circonscription du Calvados, a présidé la commission d’enquête sur l’audiovisuel public
